race.comment: EXCELS (1) former Victorian-trained filly now in the Nathan Doyle yard. Dropped in class with a tidy second over 1000m at Seymour last December. Primed with the two sharp trials and expected to go close. DYNEEMA (3) Unite And Conquer filly from Jali on debut for the Mark Milton yard. Trial form indicates she's up to a solid debut after finishing second at Scone and Muswellbrook. Well drawn and can play a leading role. EDNA MAE (4) three-year-old Outreach filly from Painted Gold on debut for the Vigouroux stable. Ran second in her latest trial over 750m at Goulburn. Finds a nice race to kick off. CYCLONE JAZ (11) covered plenty of ground first-up with a plugging sixth over 1000m at Kembla Grange. Finds a much weaker contest and stays in the mix.
